is_anopheles.evidence: Discusses Anopheles species including Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles albimanus throughout the review (e.g., page 606, 609).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Mentions kdr target-site mutations conceptually and cites Martinez-Torres et al. (Figure 1 and page 609), but does not genotype target markers in any mosquito populations.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype counts, allele frequencies, or sample sizes are reported; this is a review article.

african_field_population.evidence: No primary field collections or genotyped African field populations are evaluated.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a synopsis/review article summarizing insecticide resistance mechanisms and vector control perspectives (page 605: 'We provide an update on resistance of disease vectors to insecticides...').

sub_country_location.evidence: Not applicable as no primary empirical collection data are presented.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Not applicable as no specific primary sampling dates are reported.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable; this is a narrative review paper.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed or referenced.

assessment.summary: This article is a broad synopsis/review of insecticide resistance mechanisms, surveillance methods, and vector control implications across various disease vectors. It does not provide primary empirical genotyping data for African Anopheles field populations.
